notes.title: Another free content update!
notes.notes:
Hey pals!

We've had one update, yes, but what about second update?

You think you've got these animals right where you want them (sitting on a slight incline on a windy day), and the next thing you know they're rolling across the hills, getting into all sorts of wacky adventures. Before you know it they'll be learning the true meaning of family and getting a direct-to-DVD sequel. 

All that to say, they've rolled back to the carnival, no doubt attracted to the smell of funnel cakes and giant pretzels. There's a trail of fur and feathers leading to the hall of mirrors... Let's split up. You check out the mirror funhouse, and I'm going to go check out the funnel cakes. 

New Features

 A whole new level is now available, bringing the total up to 16
 You can now view a larger selection from the Steam Leaderboards on the Level Select menu. Tap Down or press the Leaderboards button to check the standings


Interface Improvements

 Updated the keyboard/mouse control hints to make mouse controls clearer in the instructions and in-level


Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue where daily personal bests would not reset in some situations
 Fixed a typo in one of the extras

notes.title: [Game Hotfix] - v1.1.1
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

Finally fixed the mysterious "boundary merge game over" bug! Special thanks to player "germdove" for sending a video, allowing our team of experts to analyze the issue at the subpixel level.
Fixed an issue where wooden garbage circles would still be simulated after a game over.

notes.title: First free content update!
notes.notes:
Hey pals!

Welcome to the first ever content update for Pen Pals! 

We've been busy here at the Dabbleplex, crunching the numbers into the finest powdered data and mixing that into an informational slurry. The goal? Extrapolate these figures to determine exactly what kind of new level to add to the game. 

We ran into a snag, though. While looking over the charts, a bunch of animals rolled into the office and landed on our precious graphs. We'll try to work around them, but in the meantime maybe you all could try to clear up some of these barnyard invaders. 

New Features

 A whole new level is now available, bringing the total up to 15
 You can now view Steam Leaderboards top 3 (and your immediate scoreboard neighbors) on the in-level scoreboard. Just use the buttons over on the left or the  hotkeys to switch to other scoreboard views


Interface Improvements

 Added a toggle to the options menu to cause the game to auto-pause when the window loses focus (by default, this new option is enabled) 
 Using the keyboard for swaps no longer disables mouse tracking


Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue where it was possible to click the gameover retry button before the gameover screen appeared


Thank you everyone for an exciting and successful launch! There are more still bugs to squash and new features to add, so watch for more updates on the horizon!
